fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Community Event, Conference, and Training Request

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro Copy
fields.value: Tell us about your event, audience, and request so NCMEC can review the opportunity.

fields.name: formAction
fields.label: Submit Endpoint URL
fields.description: Use http://127.0.0.1:8787/event-request for local mock testing. The original Formstack form uses https://formstack.io/CB73D and requires Formstack session tokens/captcha, so production native submits should use a backend endpoint/proxy.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Success Message
fields.value: Thank you. Your event request has been submitted.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.label: Error Message
fields.value: We could not submit your request. Please try again.

fields.name: topPadding
fields.label: Top Padding (Optional)
fields.description: Accepts CSS lengths like 64px, 4rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.

fields.name: submissionMode
fields.label: Submission Mode
fields.description: Native Form posts the redesigned form to the backend endpoint. Original Formstack Embed renders the hosted Formstack form.

fields.name: embedUrl
fields.label: Original Formstack Embed URL
fields.description: Used only when Submission Mode is Original Formstack Embed.
